{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check if the groups are balanced across key covariates
# Cross-tabulate arm with site, severity, and sex
cross_tab_site = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['site'])
cross_tab_severity = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
cross_tab_sex = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['sex'])

# Print cross-tabulations
print("Cross-tabulation: arm vs site")
print(cross_tab_site)
print("\nCross-tabulation: arm vs severity")
print(cross_tab_severity)
print("\nCross-tabulation: arm vs sex")
print(cross_tab_sex)"}
